description:
Evidence (Theseus main 51501be, read-only check 2026-11-12): a bot review thread whose first comment is edited (including, [INFERENCE] untested, ticking a task-list checkbox) is marked edited (github.py:78,134,144). Edited threads are then skipped by dedup (dedup.py:59,77: a duplicate thread can be posted), by threaded-finding carry (cli.py:1155: the defect counts as threadless) and by dispute handling (cli.py:251: disputes under it are ignored). The BenchBox merge digest marks such a thread unverifiable and drops its severity (soundness_merge_digest.py:914-917,1046,1052,538-539,616-638,1401). The gate itself is unaffected (review_check.py:137-141,381-399; protocol.py:378-382 read only review edit state).
Threads expose this because report.py:431-439 writes layout.thread_title(...) and raw finding.detail; sanitize (verdict.py:166) has no task-mark handling, unlike layout.neutralize for the body.
Scope:
1. Neutralise thread titles and details with the body's rules (task marks as code spans, `<` escaped, line-start fences and headings escaped).
2. Headings inside list items (layout.py:37 _BLOCK_START and neutralize_inline :113 only handle the start of a flattened line); add `_` to _BLOCK_START.
3. Entity-escape * _ \ ` ~ [ in shown_path (layout.py:128-130 is only html.escape).
4. Reference-style and inline <a> links in model text.
5. A dedicated dispute-evidence inertness test (report.py:687).
6. docs/consumer-policy.md:107 wording: the marker-limit NOT REVIEWED body has 'Run details' (report.py:750-761,918); reword the doc or pass pending for that case.
First step: confirm with a scratch thread whether ticking a checkbox sets lastEditedAt (owner approval needed for any live GitHub probe).
Guardrails: never change review-defect / review-finding markers or the fingerprint input; threads are never edited after posting; dedup must still match threads posted by earlier releases (test); G7 merge rule plus independent review (posting and dedup change); no live model calls.
